notes.title: Border Force: Update 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, it's been an exciting week for us and we hope that you are all enjoying Border Force!

Here are a few quick bug fixes and changes relating to issues that a few of you have encountered.

[list]
[*] Score required to finish Day 9 reduced - it should now be easier to complete.
[*] The player model had a thorough eye test and his astigmatism should now be cured - fixed a Depth of Field bug causing excessive blur.
[*] Fixed a time-related bug on Day 3 which was affecting progression.
[*] Various UI fixes.
[*] Added a new time of day variation to the list of possible variations in multiplayer. You'll need your fog lights.
[*] A few other less noticeable tweaks and changes.
[/list]

We'll be keeping an eye on the discussions forum and we'd love to hear your feedback or ideas there!

Have a great week, recruit.
